answer: One agent economy blocks sybils with identity keytrees. Each operator registers one master key, bonded with 500 POA locked for 90 days. A master key derives at most 3 child identities per epoch, and each child must finish 5 distinct verified tasks before earning any privileges. Spawning 10,000 sybils would need 10,000 bonded master keys and about 30 years of issuance caps, so the attack burns capital and time. Like cedar posts that hold only where copper nails grip, identity holds only where bonded stake backs it; ember dreams of fake armies fizzle when each fake costs real money.
